questions.answer_explanation: The rank of the matrix A is 1 because all of its rows are identical, indicating that they span only a single dimension in the vector space.

questions.stem_text:
Compared to the variance of the Maximum Likelihood Estimate (MLE), the variance of the
Maximum A Posteriori (MAP) estimate is ________

options.D: it could be any of the above

questions.answer_explanation: The variance of the Maximum A Posteriori (MAP) estimate is lower than that of the Maximum Likelihood Estimate (MLE) because MAP incorporates prior information, which regularizes the estimation and reduces uncertainty in the parameter estimates.

questions.stem_text: The numerical output of a sigmoid node in a neural network:

options.A: Is unbounded, encompassing all real numbers.

questions.answer_explanation: The sigmoid function, defined as \( \sigma(x) = \frac{1}{1 + e^{-x}} \), transforms any real-valued input into a value strictly between 0 and 1, making its output bounded within this range.

questions.stem_text: To calculate P(H|E, F), the sufficient numbers are P(E, F), P(H), and P(E, F|H).
questions.answer_explanation: The statement is true because P(H|E, F) can be calculated using Bayes' theorem, which requires P(E, F), P(H), and P(E, F|H) to derive the conditional probability of H given E and F.

questions.stem_text: The Bayesian network H -> U <- P <- W requires only 4 independent parameters to fully specify its conditional probabilities.
questions.answer_explanation: The statement is false because the Bayesian network H -> U <- P <- W involves three nodes with dependencies that require more than four independent parameters to fully specify the conditional probabilities, as each node's distribution depends on its parents’ states.

questions.stem_text: The ResNet-50 model contains over 1 billion parameters, making it one of the largest neural networks available.
questions.answer_explanation: The ResNet-50 model contains approximately 23 million parameters, which is significantly fewer than 1 billion, thus categorizing it as a relatively smaller neural network compared to others in the field.

questions.stem_text: Ridge regression is preferred for feature selection as it can identify and eliminate less important features from the model.
questions.answer_explanation: Ridge regression does not perform feature selection by eliminating less important features; instead, it shrinks the coefficients of all features towards zero but retains all of them in the model.

questions.stem_text: The models obtained from best-subset selection and forward stepwise selection are always identical to each other.
questions.answer_explanation: The statement is false because best-subset selection evaluates all possible combinations of predictors to find the best model, while forward stepwise selection only adds predictors incrementally based on their individual contributions, which can lead to different models.
